sys_app.name: PTAG Engagement Hub
sys_app.short_description: Production PTAG engagement intake with status transparency and clear ownership. Additive companion to PTAG - Intake and Assessment; no dependency on it. v2 complete (1.3.0/I10): branded portal with mobile nav + in-scope favicon; deterministic scoring engine (admin-tunable weights, decision-table banding, stamped score/band); AES assessor workspace with queues, Assessment tab and leadership dashboard; full lifecycle notification suite (9); approval-on-accept + convert-to-engagement handoff; AI layer (exec-summary skill, Completeness Chaser, Triage Assist, comparison skill - drafts only, journal-only writes, LLM never rates, all AI Control Tower-governed). Duplicate detector deferred on corpus volume (design/v2/dup_detector_deferral.md). 1.3.1 (I11 UX): CONTAINS + explicit-* wildcard search in the intake reference pickers; engagement detail modal on My Engagements with the customer-visible comment thread, guarded comment composer (PTAGHubAccess) and comment notifications N10/N11. 1.3.2 (I12 UX): landing hero panel merges the journey explainer into the pipeline rows - two-line items with the I6 state-context sub-notes, retitled 'Where your requests stand', each row an anchor into the new whitelisted ?state= filter on My Engagements (filter bar + Show all). 1.3.3 (I13 UX): landing gains a right-gutter section dot-rail + hero 'Explore' scroll cue and a track-by-number jump inside the pipeline card (-> ?id=ptag_status&number=). Track Status retired end-to-end - removed from header + footer nav, hero CTA now 'My engagements', all ptag_track references swept (7 notification templates + submit receipt repointed to ?id=ptag_status), ptag_track page + ptag_track_w widget deleted. My Engagements gains a permanent filter bar (state chips w/ viewer counts + PTAG-number filter, no-reload refilter + shareable URL sync, mutually exclusive) and the track page's state-flow timeline in two placements - the drill-in modal and a long-hover inline row peek. Seeds untouched.
